sample_requests: Run LazySlide on data/V1_Breast_Section_1.svs: tissue + 256-px tiles at 0.5 mpp + UNI2 features + a QC report.
Given this H&E slide, classify each tile as one of [tumor, stroma, necrosis, normal] using Virchow + PRISM and produce a tissue-overlay report.

smoke_commands.name: lazyslide_import_smoke
smoke_commands.command: ${PYTHON} -c "import lazyslide; import wsidata; print('OK lazyslide=' + lazyslide.__version__)"

smoke_commands.name: lazyslide_canonical_pipeline_signatures
smoke_commands.command: ${PYTHON} -c "import lazyslide as zs; assert callable(zs.pp.find_tissues); assert callable(zs.pp.tile_tissues); assert callable(zs.tl.feature_extraction); assert callable(zs.tl.feature_aggregation); assert callable(zs.tl.zero_shot_score); print('signatures OK')"
